name: tempguru-mcp
description: TempGuru MCP server for planning against a 345-entry configured US/CA market catalog, with tier-based lead-time guidance, coordinator-confirmed order coverage, ten read-only tools, a non-PII buyer handoff, and non-contact plan persistence.

scripts.build:cli: node scripts/gen-skill-digests.mjs && rm -rf cli/skills cli/index.mjs cli/LICENSE && esbuild src/mcp-stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=cli/index.mjs --banner:js='#!/usr/bin/env node' && cp -R skills cli/skills && cp LICENSE cli/LICENSE
scripts.build:okf: node scripts/gen-skill-digests.mjs && node scripts/dump-openapi.mjs && node scripts/dump-request-schema.mjs && npm run build:okf-examples && node scripts/build-okf.mjs
scripts.build:okf-examples: node distribution/okf/openapi-to-okf.mjs content/mcp-data/openapi.json distribution/okf/example --base https://mcp.tempguru.co && node distribution/okf/knowledge-catalog-contrib/openapi-to-okf/openapi-to-okf.mjs content/mcp-data/openapi.json distribution/okf/knowledge-catalog-contrib/openapi-to-okf/example --base https://mcp.tempguru.co
